groups.title: Text
groups.summary: Markup, rules and pixel lettering. Text is measured in terminal cells, so emoji and CJK keep the grid.

groups.title: Layout
groups.summary: Containers that place other widgets. Any widget can sit inside any container, including a live dashboard.

groups.title: Status and progress
groups.summary: The widgets a live session updates: facts, steps, trees, bars, phases, spinners and the log region.

groups.title: Charts
groups.summary: Bars, stacked bars, sparklines, histograms and braille line and scatter charts, all scaled to their cells.

groups.title: Overview
groups.summary: Month calendars, status maps, flows, worker lanes and run summaries: the shapes an operations report is built from.

examples.title: Progress
examples.summary: Labelled bars with a percentage and a count, in line or block shape.
examples.csharp:
Terminal.Write(new Rows()
    .Add(new ProgressBar("Build") { Value = 64, Total = 100 })
    .Add(new ProgressBar("Tests") { Value = 412, Total = 530 })
    .Add(new ProgressBar("Docs") { Value = 100, Total = 100, Status = StatusKind.Pass })
    .Add(new ProgressBar("Upload") { Value = 3, Total = 8, Shape = BarShape.Block }));
examples.powershellFull:
Import-Module ConsoleMonster

New-ConsoleRows -Content {
    New-ConsoleProgress -Label 'Build' -Value 64 -Total 100
    New-ConsoleProgress -Label 'Tests' -Value 412 -Total 530
    New-ConsoleProgress -Label 'Docs' -Value 100 -Total 100 -Status Pass
    New-ConsoleProgress -Label 'Upload' -Value 3 -Total 8 -Shape Block
} | Show-Console
examples.csharpFluent:
Ui.Rows()
    .Add(Ui.ProgressBar().Label("Build").Value(64).Total(100))
    .Add(Ui.ProgressBar().Label("Tests").Value(412).Total(530))
    .Add(Ui.ProgressBar().Label("Docs").Value(100).Total(100).Status(StatusKind.Pass))
    .Add(Ui.ProgressBar().Label("Upload").Value(3).Total(8).Shape(BarShape.Block))
    .Show();

examples.title: Status map
examples.summary: One cell per item in labelled rows, with a legend that counts each status.
examples.powershell:
# One cell per host and port, filled row by row, with a legend of counts.
$states = @(
    'Pass', 'Pass', 'Skip', 'Skip'
    'Pass', 'Warn', 'Skip', 'Skip'
    'Pass', 'Pass', 'Fail', 'Pass'
    'Skip', 'Skip', 'Pass', 'Pass'
)
New-ConsoleCellMap -InputObject $states -Columns 4 -LegendLines 2 `
    -RowLabels 'web-01', 'web-02', 'api-01', 'db-01' | Show-Console
examples.powershellFull:
Import-Module ConsoleMonster

# One cell per host and port, filled row by row, with a legend of counts.
$states = @(
    'Pass', 'Pass', 'Skip', 'Skip'
    'Pass', 'Warn', 'Skip', 'Skip'
    'Pass', 'Pass', 'Fail', 'Pass'
    'Skip', 'Skip', 'Pass', 'Pass'
)
New-ConsoleCellMap -InputObject $states -Columns 4 -LegendLines 2 `
    -RowLabels 'web-01', 'web-02', 'api-01', 'db-01' | Show-Console

examples.title: Run summary
examples.summary: One line for a whole run: bar, counters, elapsed time and time left.
examples.powershell:
# One line for the whole run: a bar, counters, elapsed time and the time left.
New-ConsoleSummaryBar -Value 30 -Total 40 -ElapsedSeconds 42 `
    -Counter ([ordered] @{ passed = 27; failed = 2; skipped = 1 }) | Show-Console
